patch_description: Inspired by the successful motif-based blocks that split three-qubit interactions by geometric category, this ansatz emphasizes line-aware ZZZ motifs on the eight winning lines while keeping a very compact, symmetry-grouped single-qubit parametrization and shared parametric CRZ couplings across the lattice. The design reduces unique parameters per block (12) by aggressive symmetry-based sharing (corners/edges/center groups and shared ring/center CRZs), concentrates three-qubit ZZZ line detectors, and keeps a single post-phase per-block. The result is a parameter-efficient, line-sensitive block that preserves expressive three-body structure where the task needs it (winning lines) while controlling depth and parameter count to improve generalization and training efficiency.
